findings.quote: // An overlay open when this reply landed would otherwise survive
findings.what: `open_or_refresh_config_pane` is also the refresh path (it carries view, env cursor and list state from an existing pane), so a re-read reply landing while the operator has the help overlay open over an already-open config pane now silently closes that overlay even though the body did not change kind; the unconditional clear should be limited to the case where the previous body was not a `ConfigPane`.
